records.title: Every day, you wake up to build your life’s work and a future of abundance, and we wake up ready to support you on that journey. In 5050, you’ll learn what it takes to be an indispensable founder, if entrepreneurship is right for you, and how to translate science into a startup. We’ll help you identify the right team, technology, and market, and coach you to become a great founder. At the Kickoff, we’ll share more about how we’ll support you on this journey, but we’ve outlined the basics in this document to help you plan ahead.
